name: DUT-OMRON: Salient Object Detection Dataset
description: DUT-OMRON is a prominent salient object detection benchmark consisting of 5,168 natural images manually selected from more than 140,000 photos, each with pixel-level ground truth masks and bounding box annotations from 5 human annotators.

publisher.name: Dalian University of Technology & OMRON Corporation

license.name: Academic Research Use
license.notes: Made freely available for academic research purposes on the official project page.

verification.notes: Verified against CVPR 2013 paper (DOI: 10.1109/CVPR.2013.407) and benchmark archive. Exactly 5,168 images with multiple human eye-fixation and segmentation masks.

size.notes: JPEG source images and PNG pixel ground-truth masks.
